name: TMS Trigger 1
definition: Instructs the POI (Point Of Interaction) how to contact the host of the terminal management system (TMS), to initiate the maintenance of the terminal.

TMSContactLevel.name: TMS Contact Level
TMSContactLevel.definition: Level of urgency in contacting the maintenance.

TMSIdentification.name: TMS Identification
TMSIdentification.definition: Identification of the host to contact for the maintenance.

TMSContactDateTime.name: TMS Contact Date Time
TMSContactDateTime.definition: Date and time for calling the maintenance.
